s: Din qatan beshabbat ubo y"a seipim: qatan haober al dibre tora lahanaato, kegon sheokel nebelot, o shemmechallel shabbat letzorko — en bet din metzuvvin lehaprisho. Abal im oseh bishbil gadol — tzarik limchot beyado middibre soperim, kemo shennitbaer besimman shl"d. Veim hu dabar hammitparsem larabbim veyesh lachush sheyyitu hashshomeim lomar sheddabar zeh muttar hu — tzarik limchot bo ap al pi sheoseh ledaat atzmo, kegon shettoqea berosh hashshana shechal lihyot beshabbat, shehaqqol nishma larabbim veyabou litot velomar shettoqein gam keshechal beshabbat:

Vekol zeh baacherim, abal abiv, kevan shehu metzuvveh middibre soperim lechannek et beno o bitto apillu bemitzvot aseh mishshehiggiu lechinnuk — kol shekken shemmechuyyab middibre soperim ligor bahem ulehaprisham millaabor al lo taaseh, vaapillu al issur shel dibre soperim. Veim enennu maprisham meissur shel tora — tzerikim habbet din limchot beyado. Abal im eno maprisham meissur dibre soperim — en tzerikim limchot beyado:

Veshiur hachinnuk bemitzvot aseh hu, bekol tinoq lepi chariputo vidiato bekol dabar lepi inyanayv, kegon hayyodea meinyan shabbat — chayyab lishmoa qiddush vehabdala, hayyodea lehitattep kahalaka — chayyab betzitzit, kemo shennitbaer besimman y"z, veken kol kayyotze bazeh, ben bemitzvat aseh shel tora ben beshel dibre soperim. Abal hachinnuk belo taaseh, ben shel tora ben shel dibrehem, hu bekol tinoq shehu bar habana shemmebin kesheomerim lo shezzeh asur laasot o leekol. Abal tinoq sheeno bar habana kelal — en abiv metzuvveh lemono beal korcho milleekol maakalot asurot, o millechallel shabbat apillu beissur shel tora, kevan sheeno mebin kelal hainyan mah shemmoneo umaprisho. Veken im hu kohen — eno tzarik lehotzio mibbayit shehattuma betoko, ella im ken hu bar habana — azay abiv metzuvveh lehotzio:
Abal immo en metzuvva alayv kelal, ben bemitzvat aseh ben belo taaseh:

Vekol zeh leinyan lehaprisho meissur, abal lispot lo issur beyadayim — asur lekol adam min hattora apillu eno bar habana kelal, shenneemar "lo toklum", upereshu chakamim "lo taakilum" liqtannim. Vaapillu debarim haasurim middibre soperim — asur lehaakilo, apillu hu tzarik lekak, vaapillu hu choleh, kol sheen bo sakkana, kemo sheasur begadol. Veken asur lehargilo bechillul shabbat umoed apillu bidbarim haasurim mishshum shebut. Venokri hammaakil issur letinoq sheeno bar habana — en abiv tzarik limchot bo. Abal asur lekol adam lomar lenokri sheyyaakilennu, shehaamira lenokri asura bekol haissurim shebbattora, vekol shekken sheasur lomar ken lehattinoq. Veim hattinoq tzarik lekak, kegon shehu qetzat choleh — muttar lomar lenokri lehaakilo, shetztzorke qatan dinam kecholeh sheen bo sakkana shehittiru bo amira lenokri apillu beissure tora, kemo shennitbaer besimman shk"ch. Veken im tzarik lishtiyyat yayin, veen sham yen yisrael ella setam yenam shel nokrim, veen hayyayin chazaq kol kak sheyyakshirennu al yede mezigat shishsha chalaqim mayim veechad yayin kemo sheyyitbaer beyoreh dea simman ql"d — muttar lomar lenokri lehashqoto lo:

Veyesh omerim shekkol shehu letzorko shel tinoq, kegon akila ushetiyya — lo gazeru bo chakamim kelal, umuttar lehaakilo beyadayim kol dabar sheen issuro ella middibre soperim im tzarik lekak, ap al pi shehiggia lechinnuk. Abal im eno tzarik lekak — asur lehaakilo apillu eno bar habana (veabiv tzarik limchot bo im hu bar habana) apillu beissur dibre soperim, shehare asur lehaniqo chaleb immo achar k"d chodesh, ap al pi sheen issur chaleb ishsha ella middibre soperim, hoil veeno tzarik lo achar k"d. Veyesh lismok al dibrehem lehaqel bedibre soperim, im hu tzarik lekak veen sham nokri lehaakilo al yado. Veap im en hattinoq tzarik lekak, ella shehaggadol tzarik lekak sheyyaaseh lo tinoq ezeh dabar haasur middibre soperim — en issur lepi sebara zo litteno lo sheyyaasehu lo, ella keshennoteno lo biqbiut tadir, sheyyesh lachush shemma yitraggel hattinoq veyissarek baasiyyat dabar zeh veyabo laasoto ap kesheyyagdil, abal keshennoteno lo beaqray bealma — en lachush lekak, raq sheyyehe beinyan sheen bo issur mah sheoseh bishbilo, kemo shennitbaer besimman shl"d, kegon letzorek mitzva. Lepikak, muttar lehatim letinoq shehiggia lechinnuk mikkos shel qiddush shemmeqaddeshin bebet hakkeneset, ap al pi shehattinoq eno tzarik kelal litima zo veyakol hu lehamtin millitom ad sheyyishma haqqiddush shebbimqom seudda bebet abiv hamchanneko lezeh, ap al pi ken kevan sheissur hatteima qodem haqqiddush hu middibre soperim veyesh lanu tzorek bitima zo, veen leosrah ella mishshum shemma yissarek bah hattinoq, vezeh en lachush beqiddush shebbebet hakkeneset, sheen matimim lehattinoqot biqbiut bekol shabbat veshabbat, shellipamim yesh orechim hashshobetim veokelim bechadre bet hakkeneset veshomeim haqqiddush mishsham, veaz en tzarik kelal lehatim letinoqot, kemo shennitbaer besimman rs"t:

Vekol zeh keshemmaakilim issur letinoq letzarekkenu, veken im omerim lo laasot lanu ezeh dabar haasur apillu middibre soperim. Abal kol shehu tzorko shel tinoq vetaqqanato — lo chasheshu bo shemma yissarek bekak veyaaseh ken liksheyyigdal, lepi sheyyadua lo shebbeshbil shehu qatan mattirin lo tzerakayv, velo yiteh mizzeh laasot ken kesheyyigdal. Velaken muttar lehaakilo qodem qiddush im hu rotzeh leekol, veken lishtot, veasur leannoto, veken kol kayyotze bazeh bishar kol issure dibre soperim:

Kol dabar shehu mishshum chinnuk mitzva — muttar lispot lo issur beyadayim, kegon lehaakil pesach leqatan shehiggia lechinnuk, ap al pi shello nimna alayv, veen happesach neekal ella limnuyayv, ap al pi ken kevan shemmitkavven lechanneko bemitzvot — muttar. Abal mitzva shello shayyak bah chinnuk, dehaynu shello yukal laasotah kesheyyigdal, shezzehu iqqar taam hachinnuk, kegon lehatimo mikkos shel mila beyom hakkippurim kede shello tehe habberaka niret lebattala, ap al pi shezzehu tzorek mitzva, mikkol maqom kevan shekkesheyyigdal yeesor lo — laken gam akshav asur, mishshum shemma yissarek bekak veyitom mimmennu gam kesheyyigdal, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman trk"a. Velaken kol shebut shemmuttar laasotan al yede nokri letzorek mitzva — asur laasoto al yede qatan, mishshum shemma yissarek bekak, im lo beaqray bealma, kemo shennitbaer lemala:

Asur litten letinoq chagab chay tame lischoq bo, shemma yamut veyoklennu, venimtza maakilo issur beyadayim, kevan shehu natan lo haissur, vekol shekken dabar haasur harauy leoklo kak. Vaapillu dabar sheen bo issur ella mishshum "bal teshaqqetzu" — asur litten lo im yesh lachush sheyyoklennu. Abal muttar litten lo op tame lischoq bo, mippene sheap kesheyyamut eno rauy laakila kak:

(Vekol zeh beissure maakalot, vaapillu hu issur shehazzeman gorem), abal muttar litten letinoq beshabbat chapatzim sheyyakol laasot bahem melaka leatzmo, vaapillu im yadua sheyyaaseh bahem, kegon litten letinoq uga shekketubim aleha otiyyot sheasur leoklah beshabbat, kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"m, ap al pi shehattinoq yoklenna bevadday, kevan shemmitkavven hu lahanaat atzmo — en tzarik lehaprisho, kemo shennitbaer lemala. Raq shello yitten gadol letok piv shel tinoq:

Qatan shehikka abiv, o abar shear aberot beqatnuto, ap al pi sheeno tzarik teshuba kesheyyigdal, mikkol maqom tob lo sheyyeqabbel al atzmo ezeh dabar litshuba ulekappara, ap al pi sheabar qodem shennaasa bar onashin. Uleinyan dabar shebbemamon — yitbaer bechoshen mishpat simman shn"t:
